create_ConditionalTransformerDecoderMode: create a ConditionalTransformerDecoderModel with a transformer frontend, decoder, projection, and max target sequence length
test_encode: test the encode method that normalizes and returns input sequence embeddings
test_decode: test the decode method that applies the decoder frontend and transformer decoder with encoder output
